title: licaria mexicana
intro: Licaria mexicana, commonly known as the Mexican plum or plum yew, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Licaria mexicana include its ability to act as an antioxidant, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for treating pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Licaria mexicana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
